title: Pinewood Dialogues
content: If you like movies and you listen to podcasts, you'll enjoy thePinewood Dialogues from the Museum of the Moving Image.The Pinewood Dialogues are interviews with influential actors and directors from the world of movies and television, who often come to the Museum of the Museum Image to present their work to a live audience and then talk about it afterward.Warner Brothers animation directorChuck Jones dialog:"We never had a direct contact with an audience, and no one ever wrote about us in those days."Pixar's "Incredibles" directorBrad Bird dialog:"CG films aren't made by computer. They're made by people fighting the computer."There are 123 podcasts in all, includingJim Jarmusch,Ang Lee,Harold Ramis,Tommy Lee Jones,David Cronenberg, and many others.
